description: Defines data structures and interfaces related to reporting endpoints and endpoint groups in the net namespace, including classes for identifying, configuring, and managing reporting endpoints and their associated metadata.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey
classes.description: Identifies a unique group of reporting endpoints based on network, origin, optional reporting source, and group name.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a reporting endpoint with configuration details, statistics, and validation status.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint::EndpointInfo
classes.description: Contains URL, priority, and weight information for a reporting endpoint.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint::Statistics
classes.description: Tracks upload attempts and successes for reporting endpoints.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: Defines a set of reporting endpoints associated with an origin, including subdomain inclusion and TTL.

classes.name: CachedReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: In-memory or persistent storage representation of a reporting endpoint group, including expiration and last used timestamps.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ReportingEndpointGroupKey.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the ReportingEndpoint instance is valid.
